summary: Área de Material Airport (RCU/SAOC) serves the city of Río Cuarto in central Argentina's Córdoba Province. The name reflects its origins as a military aviation facility, and it now functions as the main commercial airport for the region, serving both domestic flights and general aviation. Located in the agricultural heartland of Argentina, it provides important connectivity for one of the country's key inland cities.
faqs:
Q: Where is Área de Material Airport located?
A: It is located in Río Cuarto, in the southern part of Córdoba Province, Argentina, approximately 10 km from the city center.

Q: What type of airport is RCU?
A: It is classified as a medium-sized airport serving primarily domestic commercial flights and general aviation.

Q: Does the airport handle international flights?
A: The airport primarily handles domestic routes; international travelers typically connect through larger hubs like Buenos Aires or Córdoba.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: The terminal offers standard amenities including a waiting area, check-in counters, and basic passenger services typical of regional Argentine airports.
transport_tips: The most common way to reach the airport from Río Cuarto is by taxi or remise (private car), which is readily available throughout the city and takes around 15-20 minutes. Rental cars are also an option for travelers wishing to explore the surrounding Córdoba countryside. There is no dedicated airport shuttle service, so arranging ground transport in advance is recommended.
local_tip: If you have time before or after your flight, ask a local about the nearby Río Cuarto Reservoir (Embalse Río Cuarto) — it is one of the few natural lakes in the region and a great spot for fishing and relaxation just a short drive from the airport.
